name: Perspective Slide Carousel
description: Full-screen dark carousel of large editorial cards laid out in 3D perspective, with side slides rotated, scaled and blurred, autoplay progress bar, drag, keyboard and pagination controls.
contents: Cards with background image, kicker, title, text and a call-to-action label
Prev/next buttons with counter, line pagination, top progress bar
behavior: Autoplay advances on an interval, pauses on hover and drag
Drag or swipe with release velocity to change slides, arrow keys navigate
Neighbor slides rotate, shrink and blur by depth, with pointer-driven parallax on card content
Reduced 3D intensity on tablet, mobile and Firefox
editableByProps: Slides, all text, button labels and images
Autoplay interval, transition time, 3D depth, rotation, scale, blur and spacing
Background, card and text colors, keyboard control

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card counter number or corner marks

fixed: Arrow key listener on window is removed on unmount
Card image opacity and grayscale hover effect are fixed
